day: Day 1: Delhi to Pondicherry – Arrival & French Colony Walk
activities: Morning: Take a flight from Delhi to Chennai, then a 3–4 hour scenic drive to Pondicherry.
Afternoon: Check-in at a heritage hotel or guesthouse in White Town.
Evening: Take a leisurely walk in the French Quarter — explore colonial buildings, colorful lanes, and seaside promenades.
Night: Dinner at a French café or rooftop restaurant.
Morning: Visit Promenade Beach and enjoy sunrise views.
Late Morning: Explore Aurobindo Ashram and nearby Manakula Vinayagar Temple.
Afternoon: Visit Basilica of the Sacred Heart of Jesus and do some café hopping in White Town.
Evening: Shop at local boutiques for handmade products and Auroville crafts.
Morning: Take a trip to Auroville (approx. 30 minutes from Pondicherry).
Late Morning: Visit the Matrimandir (outer viewing) and explore Auroville’s eco-village and art centers.
Afternoon: Try organic meals at Auroville’s cafes and shop for handmade goods.
Evening: Return to Pondicherry and relax near Rock Beach.
Morning: Head to Serenity Beach for sunrise and optional surfing lessons.
Afternoon: Visit Paradise Beach via boat ride and enjoy sunbathing or beach volleyball.
Evening: Explore local seafood joints or try a sunset cruise (seasonal).

day: Day 5: Local Markets & Departure to Delhi
activities: Morning: Enjoy breakfast at a beachside café and stroll through Goubert Market for souvenirs.
Late Morning: Check out from hotel and start your journey back to Chennai Airport.
Evening: Fly back to Delhi with colorful memories of Pondicherry.
